reason: My broker already gives me AI tools for free, and I can ask Claude about my portfolio whenever I want. A paid plan with no price, on a broker that hasn't been named, isn't something I'd sign up for, even just the waitlist.
objection: I'd have to move real money off Robinhood to an unnamed broker partner and pay a monthly fee, just so an AI agent dressed up as a cartoon pet can do rebalancing I already handle myself in a few taps.
would_change_my_mind: If it hooked into my existing broker account instead of making me move my money, and a few months of the demo showed the agent actually doing better than my own trades.
